h:
这是修复手部的工作流程。它有点作用。

如何安装

  1. 安装冲击包自定义节点；

  2. 安装ControlNet-aux自定义节点；

  3. 下载hand_yolo_8s模型并将其放入“\ComfyUI\models\ultralytics\bbox";

  4. 下载深度控制网络 (SD1.5)或深度控制网络 (SDXL)模型。不的手工精炼机专门为其制作的模型。将其放入“ComfyUI\模型\controlnet\"

  5. 下载坏手5嵌入并将其放入“\ComfyUI\models\embeddings";

注释

  • 使用的SD模型是异种气体，因为它是半现实的，用手也可以。您可以尝试使用制作图像所用的模型。

  • 使用SDXL模型即可，但要选择匹配的ControlNet。嵌入将被忽略。

  • 这不是魔法。工作流程只是修复，不会改变颜色分布。因此，很难找回失去的手指，也很难摆脱多余的手指。现在，正式来说，这就是魔法。

o.en:
This a workflow to fix hands. It somewhat works.

How to install

  1. InstallImpact Packcustom nodes;

  2. InstallControlNet-auxcustom nodes;

  3. Downloadhand_yolo_8smodel and put it in "\ComfyUI\models\ultralytics\bbox";

  4. DownloadDepth ControlNet (SD1.5)orDepth ControlNet (SDXL)model.NOTtheHandRefinermodel made specially for it. Put it in "ComfyUI\model\controlnet\"

  5. Downloadbad-hands-5embedding and put it in "\ComfyUI\models\embeddings";

Notes

  • The SD model used isXenoGasm, because it's semi-realistic and OK with hands. You can try to use the model you made the image with.

  • Using SDXL model is OK, but select matching ControlNet. Embedding will be ignored.

  • It's not magic. Workflow is just inpaint, and it will not change the color distribution. So, it's hard to get back missing finger, or get rid of extra one. It's now, officially, magic.
